description: Structured extraction output for one source document.

publicationDate.description: Document publication date in YYYY-MM-DD form, or null when it is not stated.

reportingPeriods.description: Reporting periods referenced by extracted metric items.

code.description: Candidate canonical period code, such as FY2025, H1_2025, or H2_2025.

label.description: Reporting period label supported by the document.

periodType.description: Reporting period type supported by the database.

startDate.description: Reporting period start date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

endDate.description: Reporting period end date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

extractionItems.description: Metric values extracted from the source document and awaiting backend validation.

periodCode.description: Code of an entry in reportingPeriods.

metricCode.description: Metric code from the catalogue supplied with the request.

rawValue.description: Value exactly as displayed in the source, including signs, symbols, and scale labels.

numericValue.description: Value normalized to the base unit defined by unit.

unit.description: Metric unit supported by the database.

dimensionType.description: Dimension type from the catalogue, or null when no matching dimension is available.

dimensionCode.description: Dimension code from the catalogue, or null when no matching dimension is available.

sourcePage.description: One-based source page or logical source section number.

sourceText.description: Short verbatim evidence containing the metric label, value, and period context.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence between zero and one.
